prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 50.8 °C (64% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 55.8 °C (55% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 57.3 °C (47% above healthy). Thermal equilibrium is compromised, causing fluid temperature to rise well above nominal operating limits.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.40 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.83 s (within 1% of healthy). Valve switching latency remains tightly within normal healthy tolerances.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.57 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 363 W·min/l (5% below healthy). Flow delivery and motor electrical consumption match expected volumetric efficiency without leakage.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.6 bar (2% below healthy). Pressure buffering is largely ineffective due to compromised pre-charge pressure in the accumulator.

tslm_prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 51.3 °C (66% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 56.0 °C (56% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 57.4 °C (48% above healthy). Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.39 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.85 s (within 1% of healthy). Directional valve actuates cleanly with no discernible switching hesitation.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.59 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 363 W·min/l (5% below healthy). No internal bypassing detected; volumetric efficiency is optimal.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.5 bar (2% below healthy). Elevated pressure ripple across working lines indicates moderate degradation of accumulator pre-charge.
